description: This file defines a utility class ColorScaler used for scaling colors based on a provided scale factor, mainly converting between RGB and HSB color spaces and interpolating colors.

classes.name: ColorScaler
classes.description: Utility class for color scaling based on a scale factor, providing methods to convert between RGB and HSB color spaces and interpolate colors.

methods.name: getScaledColor
methods.description: Returns a color scaled between min and max colors based on the input scale factor. Handles special cases of scale 0.0 and NaN.

methods.name: rgbToHsb
methods.description: Converts an RGB Color object to its HSB components and stores them in a provided float array.
